messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick heads-up — eng reported a backpressure event in the dedicated ingestion pool that delayed several onboarding reindexes between 14:10-14:32 PT. Affected: 6 accounts (mix trial & paid). Need coordinated customer status + credits + reschedule support.
Ben (CS Ops): Please drop the list and any renewal-risk flags; I can draft two short templates (trial vs paid POC).
Kira (Eng): Root cause: transient GPU memory pressure during a capacity shuffle caused the worker pool to shed connections; some streaming ingests hit backoff and timed out. We scaled the pool and drained queues by 14:40 PT. No data exposure.
AlertBot: Incident INC-2026-500 created: dedicated-pool-backpressure. Severity: P2.
Ibrahim (Onboarding): I have two orientation sessions this afternoon. Which customers should I call to reschedule?
Priya (CSM): Affected customers: CartGrid, PaperMint, BeaconEdge, MetricLoop, CounselSync (paid POC), NovaForms (paid POC). Prioritize CounselSync and CartGrid for retention risk.
Ben (CS Ops): Draft status note: "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We experienced a short delay in onboarding imports between 14:10-14:32 PT due to backpressure in our dedicated ingestion pool. Our team increased capacity and reprocessed affected jobs; most work is complete and the rest should finish within the hour.

We will follow up with an RCA and account-specific remediation. Your CSM will contact you about any rescheduling or credit offers.

- Redwood Customer Success"
Kira (Eng): Postmortem timeline: public draft in 48 hours. Fix: add pre-shuffle safety checks, improve warm-worker guarantees, and surface backpressure alerts earlier.
Luis (Billing): Provisional credit guidance: for paid POCs approve up to $1,800 pending CSM notes. Flagging CounselSync for expedited review.
Ibrahim (Onboarding): I'll call CartGrid and BeaconEdge now and offer a make-good onboarding slot. Priya — can you handle CounselSync outreach?
Priya (CSM): Yes, I'll call CounselSync and NovaForms and offer a priority troubleshooting slot plus a personalized requeue report.
Ben (CS Ops): Sending status to all impacted now with ticket refs. Please paste any customer replies here.
AlertBot: Validation: requeues completed 6/6 at 15:05 PT. Incident status: mitigated.
Ibrahim (Onboarding): Adding a "post-incident feedback" checkbox to each onboarding ticket to capture UX or error messaging issues.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. Capture sentiment and escalate any renewal chatter to me; I'll follow up after the 48h postmortem.
